purpose: Pinned upstream WoWSims sources for Skrra era-aware simulation integration.

reference_exporter.note: Reference for import schema only. The upstream addon targets modern Classic interfaces, so Skrra ships its own Interface 30300 bridge.

policy.upgrade_authority: WoWSims engine result for the exact era/spec when the model is supported and validated.
policy.no_static_fallback: Do not silently fall back to Pawn or invented stat weights when a sim model is unsupported.
policy.explanation: GearAdvisor explains the simulated trade using baseline/candidate metrics plus cap/stat deltas.
